preprocessing.name: canonical256_jpegmixed_familyconditioned_methodadversarial_letterbox299
preprocessing.source_decode: Pillow decode followed by RGB conversion
preprocessing.train_only_augmentation: random horizontal flip p=0.5 followed by one uniformly sampled JPEG quality

objective.classification: class-weighted binary cross-entropy on all Real/Fake training samples
objective.method_discriminator: one 2048->256->2 MLP per family; Real samples are excluded
objective.family_loss_aggregation: equal mean over family heads represented in the batch
objective.gradient_reversal_schedule: DANN logistic ramp over all optimizer steps
objective.purpose: retain binary forgery supervision while suppressing method identity only within each forgery family

optimization.epoch_sampling: all 39600 unique training images once per epoch with the frozen 50:50 Real/Fake marginal
optimization.comparison_budget: same unique-image count and one-view backbone forward-pass count as M7 Mixed-JPEG

model_selection.reason: keep checkpoint selection directly comparable with M7 Mixed-JPEG without using development-unseen or WildDeepfake
